data.title: 橘美花莉 · 摄影棚的金色花嫁
data.description: 【漫展摄影棚·黄昏】美花莉穿着细节华丽的白金婚纱站在柔光背景前，微卷的栗棕长发绕过头纱，手里捧着圣洁的花束；她熟练摆出镜头角度后，忽然收起营业笑容，给镜头一个真实的害羞眨眼。
data.action: 柔光棚下完成镜头角度后收起营业笑，给镜头真实害羞眨眼
data.lighting: golden studio light with soft pastel backdrop
data.mood: 职业偶像也会为花嫁心动
data.promptProse: Mikari Tachibana from 2.5 Dimensional Seduction wears a white-and-gold bridal gown with a layered veil, satin corset, gold ribbons and a fantasy bouquet. She poses beneath the studio softbox with a bouquet styled for a romantic shoot. Turning her chestnut brown hair into the light, with pink ribbons peeking through her soft curls, she performs one perfect camera angle, then lets her model smile soften into a shy wink. Golden studio light with soft pastel backdrop.
